paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: : figure
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets associated with different researcher locations over time. The horizontal axis represents the year, ranging from 2012 to 2022, and is marked with tick labels every year. The vertical axis represents the number of datasets, scaled logarithmically and ranging from 10⁰ to 10², with tick labels spaced by powers of 10.  The bars represent the number of datasets originating from various locations: Researcher Location (blue), Other (orange), UK (red), USA (yellow), IT (purple), IN (green), DE (brown). The tallest bar corresponds to the year 2021, with a value of approximately 8,000 datasets, while the shortest bar, representing 2013, shows a value of approximately 500 datasets.  The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized.  The chart displays a generally increasing trend in the total number of datasets over the years shown.
